Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid

Class GatheringNetwork

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid.GatheringNetwork
public final class GatheringNetwork extends Object
Tree-shaped gathering network between the wells and one fixed-pressure boundary (separator or host arrival).

Nodes are manifolds, tie-in points, PLETs or a riser base; every node except the boundary has one branch leading towards the boundary. A branch is a flowline, a riser or any chain of them, described by a lift model that returns the branch inlet pressure for the commingled surface rates and the outlet pressure. With the well rates given, solvePressures() walks from the boundary upstream and returns the pressure of every node; the wells then respond to the pressure of the node they are tied to. Each branch model is a CorrectedVlpProvider, so a fast lift curve can be corrected against, or replaced by, a full multiphase pipe model without changing the network.

Basis of every branch lift model: oil rate in Sm3/day, water cut as fraction of the liquid and gas-oil ratio in Sm3/Sm3 of the commingled stream. Looped networks are outside this class; use LoopedPipeNetwork for the hydraulics of a looped system.
